findings.body: This test constructs `ChatService` with a fake resolver that fabricates the combined leaf targets and a fake executor that returns a fixed result without running `SqlBuilder` or the warehouse. It asserts only the scope passed to that fake, not that the Ask endpoint returns combined lines equal to each plant's statement or preserves the singleton statement line by line. It would therefore pass if the real resolver-to-SQL integration dropped or double-counted leaves. The existing warehouse projection test bypasses the Ask entry point and was skipped in the supplied close run, so the required user-facing behavior still lacks end-to-end proof through the real API and database.
findings.title: Not done: end-to-end combined-statement Ask test
